about: Every test that uses development parts under the ML plan of 2026-10 (docs/research/ml-plan-2026-10.md, step 0). Each entry gives its plan, the parts and bands it used, its gate, and its outcome. A step's gate is entered before its results exist; 'outcome' is filled after. Held-out uses stay in docs/validation-datasets.json (held_out_uses).

tests.gate: descriptive (knob ceiling's rules): stage 1 (e) vs knob ceiling's EQ stage and (f) vs M, judge-only; 'a lot' band-weighted <= -0.10 with most bands better, 'little' >= -0.04 (undecided). Stage 2: wet only if >= 0.005 better on the search half; blind listening decides: wet on >= 7/8 trials = judge-searched effects help; 5-6/8 undecided; <= 4 don't
tests.outcome: done 2026-10-15 (Morgan; Tone King deferred): stage 1 (e) vs EQ stage -0.023 [-0.033,-0.013], band-weighted -0.028, 13/14 bands: 'little', undecided; pedals about half of it (ablation +0.010), wider input gain nothing. Stage 2: 14/48 cells wet; judge -0.010 [-0.022,+0.002]. Listening 4 wet of 7 answered (declared rule set aside as the wrong question); wet on all 3 clear-gain trials, splits on near-ties; letter layout alternated (B 6/7), listener replayed every clip and the user accepts the picks. Decision: effects stay in the search, kept only on a clear gain; a higher keep margin to be declared.

tests.gate: per arm, held half, band-weighted vs S on the per-part unit: (1) <= -0.03 and >= 40% of K_S's band-weighted gain; (2) better than S in >= 60% of bands; (3) neither clean nor crunch worse than S by > 0.05; (4) arm A not worse than the C' menu pick by > 0.01; (5) arm B: positive control and shuffled-input control pass. Arm A known-target control rows as declared. Readout per the ML plan's step 6
tests.outcome: done 2026-10-16 (audited): no arm passed. K_S -0.269 (14/14). Arm A failed by its known-target control (3/9 vs 9/9 true DI); descriptive -0.078 [-0.157,+0.002] vs S, -0.062 [-0.112,-0.012] vs C' menu pick. Arm B failed: positive control 0/4 folds; vs S +0.035 [-0.038,+0.108], 6/14; = constant; shuffled passes; not data-limited (+0.017). Audit: pipeline correct, model weak; control rendered via raw DI (fix makes it fail harder; no re-run used). Arm C not run.

tests.gate: Step A (provisional; m_A, mask v, lags 0 and -52 must agree): >= 15 of 18 informative searches agree with gap closed >= 50%, AND within the C' run m_A > 0 on >= 2 of 3 successes and m_A <= 0 on >= 4 of 6 failures -> provisional gate; 13-14 or the C' row fails -> screen only; <= 12 -> not adopted. Final only if the pre-registered per-cell predictions for experiment 3's control re-runs agree on >= two-thirds of informative searches. Step B (primary m_full, measure-DI mask for D1/D2; inversions counted on informative cells with base m > 0; halves, other mask and leave-one-band-out reported as fragility): placebo smear inverts > 1 -> D1 undecided. D1: crest -3 dB inverts >= half (rounded up) of reached cells with >= 5 reached, and the C'-spectrum rung inverts <= 1 -> dynamics confirmed; crest holds and C'-spectrum >= 2 -> dynamics and tilt; crest fails and C'-spectrum >= half -> tilt, not dynamics; else neither. D2: a transplant (5 ms, 10 ms, or oracle-EQ + 10 ms) restores if m > 0 on >= two-thirds of the base set and on more cells than C'. D3: a proxy is adopted if band-weighted within-cell Spearman rho >= 0.6, the paired band-clustered bootstrap lower 90% bound of (rho - coherence's rho) > 0, and it beats coherence in >= 5 of 6 bands; confirmation on other development cells is binding before any use as a loss.
tests.outcome: done 2026-10-15 (840 renders + 81 audit): step A 14/18 -> screen only (C' run 5/9, rho 0). D1 neither (crest-3 1/7, C'-spectrum 1/9, placebo 0/9). D2 'restores' by count (transplant 8/9 vs C' 5/9) but recovers ~6% of C' margin loss (0.053->0.064 vs 0.244); oracle EQ alone passes the same count; read as no substantive restore. D3 none adopted. C' error is fine structure (<10 ms). Experiment 3 not run; experiment 4 redesigned for fine structure.

tests.weights: Mega-53 v1 (ZFTurbo/Music-Source-Separation-Training v1.0.21, commit ea7eb9c, ckpt sha256 c62820893bbf86d4e734f966bd142d9157cfc8bb8e79e9d8f9ea553f3ff3519f), user-approved 2026-10-15
tests.gate: Descriptive screen, not a gate (the margin agrees with search success on 14 of 18 only). Cells: 5 parts x PR12, SW50R; informative = d_S - d_T >= 0.1 (full window, measure DI, clean fake). Primary m_full. A row (mega53, blend) earns the merged report's full switching test only if m_sep > 0 on more informative cells than htdemucs_6s, AND no informative cell flips from m_sep > 0 (htdemucs_6s) to m_sep <= 0, AND its mean real-song 1-3 kHz coherence (check-2 measure, the part's fold C') >= htdemucs_6s's - 0.02. Coherence alone never advances a row; m_both is reported, not gating. Reading on htdemucs_6s, independent of the screen: m_sep <= 0 on <= 1 informative cell -> separation isn't what breaks the objective; on >= ceil(n/3) -> co-equal problem, re-test promoted; else partial. n < 4 informative, or an htdemucs_6s lag-check failure on an informative cell -> undecided. Fragility (m_A, m_B, other mask, leave-one-part-out with n' rescaling) reported beside each verdict.
tests.outcome: done 2026-10-16 (136 renders; audited): informative 10/10; m_sep>0 htdemucs 9/10 (mean 0.113), Mega-53 10/10 (0.110), clean 0.221; reading not-separation (1 inversion), robust. Mega-53 advances by rule on one cell (get-out-of-bed PR12), fragile without that part, mean delta -0.003: no evidence it separates better. Blend doesn't advance (2 cells stopped by +-1 relative lag; labelled flips, harsher than the plan). m_both: htdemucs 6/10, Mega-53 7/10, clean 7/10: the rebuild is the bigger break.

tests.training: fine-tunes of C' per K3 fold from models-cprime(-f{f}) into models-fs-<arm>-f{f}; fold 3 first; cprime-folds' fold-leak rules and preflight counts; leak asserted against each network's actual training pool; seed 0; 5,150 steps, 200-step warm-up to 1e-4, cosine to 2e-5. Arms 1z (L_C' only, noise control), 1a, 1b, 1c, 1e (contingent). Loss weights by 0d's share rule, calibrated once on fold 3; 50-batch means and final weights recorded here before step 1a
tests.gate: Full known-target control only (margin reported, never gating). Step 4 passes if >= 6 of 9 informative cells close >= 50% of the gap, or the informative-cell mean shortfall <= measure-DI run's + 0.03 = -0.0315 (one-sided); the 5 non-fold-3 cells reported apart. Step 2 (fold 3, 4 cells, stricter than the readout's <6-cell mode): go if >= 3 of 4 close >= 50% or mean shortfall <= -0.013; stop if <= 2 of 4 and mean > +0.171; else undecided. At most 3 arms rendered (1a, 1b, better of 1c/1e by 1d's 1-ms crest). If any arm reads go or undecided, 1z is rendered at lag 0; if 1z meets go, gains are attributed to fine-tuning; an arm beats 1z only with more cells closed or a mean shortfall >= 0.03 lower; tie-break 1z, 1a, 1b, 1e, 1c. Any go wins; only undecided arms (no go) take the fold-1 branch (user's yes; per-arm fold-1 fine-tunes): 7 cells, go if >= 5 of 7 or mean <= -0.048, stop if <= 4 of 7 and mean > +0.202, else undecided and ask. Step 5: the control's own rule with amendment 2 on a fresh 12-cell draw, band-weighted with leave-one-band-out; row 1 there -> undecided, ask the user; only a pass re-runs arm A. 1d hard stops are breakage guards only (val ratio > C' + 0.02, check 2 < 0.1126, 3-8 kHz > C' + 2 dB); crest and gap reported and used only to rank. 0c opens E1' (for experiment 4 only) if DAC-9 keeps m > 0 on 4 of 4 fold-3 cells, fold-3 mean m >= 0.75 x the true DI's (0c's own scoring), 1-ms crest within 1 dB.

User's yes needed for the fold-1 branch, a fourth arm, a hedge control beyond the reservation, E1' renders, second seeds, and anything past 200k

tests.gate: Diagnostic. Units informative if d_S, d_T and the target are finite on the held half and d_S - d_T >= 0.1; non-finite units dropped and listed; refused candidates count as not closing and are out of means. Counts are unweighted unit shares within a fold; means band-weighted; pooled band-clustered 90% intervals; fragile = a fold pass flips with one band left out. Set-up: pre-flight repeat <= 1e-3 on non-target renders, target repeat within 1e-3 on >= 95% of targets, >= 40 informative units per fold after top-up, top-mean parity. R1 (per view): top mean closes >= 50% on >= 2/3 and strictly closer than the bank median on >= 2/3. R2 (per view): best-of-K truncated-normal samples (K=4 view 1a, 8 view 1b) picked on the search half close >= 50% on >= 2/3 and mean held log ratio <= -0.03 vs best-of-K random labels and vs best-of-K S-jitters. Per view R1/R2: pass = every fold, none fragile; undecided (ask the user) = 3 of 4 folds, or any fragile pass (fold 3 included); else fail. R3: R1 passes on 1a and fails on 1b, or R2 at K=4 passes on 1a and fails on 1b at K=4. R4 (pool: every distinct setting for the target except target, repeat and S, on the unit's held half; pooled unweighted per fold): >= 1/3 of renders closing >= 50% lie >= 0.2 mean knob distance from the target, and >= 2 of the 4 continuous-only target jitters close >= 50% on >= 2/3 of units. R4': that share < 10% and band-weighted within-unit Spearman(knob distance, gap closed) <= -0.5. Neither or folds split: between. Triggers (first match): set-up fails -> stop; R1 on 1b -> rung 2, no experiments 2-3; R2 on 1b -> 3A (or arm C if experiment 4 passes), step 1.3 offered (ask first; 'renders only' puts rung 3 before any product step); R1/R2 undecided -> ask the user; R3 -> experiment 2 as confirmation, then song-robustness; both views fail -> experiment 2, then by R4 (3B), R4' (front-end follow-up), between (experiment 2 alone decides). Flags: collapse (median mode separation sum_k pi_k|mu_k - mu_bar| / sum_k pi_k sigma_k over audible settings < 0.5 in >= 3 of 4 folds; threshold set after the audit was readable) picks 3B's flow head; label sampling (K_S-prior half meets R1/R2 counts, broad half not, >= 3 of 4 folds); flat settings (median Delta-judge < 0.05) dropped from knob diagnostics
tests.renders: budgeted ~7.9k (pre-flight ~10, step 1.1 <= 7,080, step 1.2 ~0.8k), hard stop 8.2k including any top-up; step 1.3 ~2.3k ask-first, only on row 2. Running total ~132-133k actual + experiment 4's ~11.1k declared = ~144k; with experiment 1 ~152k; with step 1.3 ~154.5k of 200k. CPU only, <= 3 render processes counting experiment 4's, torch and separation at 2 threads, memory guard
tests.outcome: done 2026-10-16 (7,890 renders; audited; set-up and PIT bugs fixed): B top vs S on render targets -0.39 [-0.48,-0.30] (light view), -0.16 [-0.26,-0.06] (song-like); best-of-8 by true judge -0.54 (-0.17 vs best-of-8 random). Collapse: one wide mode per knob. On records the prior points away (density rho +0.13); weakest on gain/switches. Trigger row 7 (experiment 2); 3B (sound-space training) best supported.

tests.gate: None (the user's rule of 2026-10-16). Measured: held-half true-DI log ratio against S and against stored full A, per part (mean over amps and directions), band-weighted with 90% band-clustered intervals; part-weighted, leave-one-band-out, per amp and per class reported, descriptive. Experiment 2: rank fidelity (menu Spearman, search half; non-finite presets dropped pairwise; an ensemble member at inf makes the preset inf), menu pick held log ratio, pick regret. Only the band-weighted pooled mean decides. Decision: best estimate; a candidate whose paired 90% interval with the best contains 0 is a tie (fold-3 steps: the wider of the band (2 df) and part (4 df) intervals); among the best and its ties the first in the frozen cost order is chosen. Exp 1 order: S, C-blend, B-blend, C' menu pick, A, S-mics, shrink-0.5, shrink-0.25, shrink-0.75 (dirs-avg reported, not eligible). Exp 2 order: C', 1z, 1a, 1b, E4={C',1z,1a,1b}; deciding lag -52 - (GCC lag vs C'). 2b only if exp 2 leaves a tie, deciding among the tied set by local fidelity. Exp 3: 3-C' (zero-render replay of the stored main stage) vs S and full A on 142 directions; 3a: S, 3-C', full A, 3-W on fold 3; 3b only if 3a chooses 3-W; E4 in 3b needs the user's yes. Experiment 4's step-2 readings are descriptive here; its gate is not amended
